nodes.name: 7am Weekdays
nodes.notes: Runs Mon–Fri at 7 AM. Change to '0 7 * * *' to include weekends.

nodes.name: Get Channel History
nodes.notes:
Fetches last 24h of messages from #core-facility-calendar (C0B8SPZLPUM).
Bot must be a member of the channel. Uses home-n8n bot credential.

nodes.name: Parse Absences
nodes.notes:
Looks for lines like 'Name off  (member1@example.com)'.
Returns empty array (stops pipeline) if no absences found.

nodes.name: Team Members
nodes.notes:
TEST_MODE = true → only Team Member 1 gets emails.
Set TEST_MODE = false to enable all 4 recipients.

nodes.name: Dedup & Split
nodes.notes: One output item per new absence. Empty output stops the pipeline (no emails).

nodes.name: Send Gmail
nodes.notes:
Replace YOUR_GMAIL_CREDENTIAL_ID with your Gmail credential ID from n8n.
The email is sent to ALL team members in the toList field.
